instruction: Cinematic film still, low-angle medium full shot. On a gym floor in front of a red wall with a white knight mural, two men rest after training. On the left, the shirtless young man with short dark hair (R1) sits on the floor, leaning back on his left hand. On the right, the shirtless bearded man with a shoulder tattoo (R3) sits on his knees. The young man (R1) and the bearded man (R3) clasp their right hands together in a respectful gesture. A strong backlight shines from behind them, creating a bright flare and highlighting their sweaty skin.
